rdd2022.official_name: Road Damage Dataset 2022 (Crowdsensing-based Road Damage Detection Challenge)
rdd2022.attribution_requirement: Arya et al., 'RDD2020: An annotated image dataset for automatic road damage detection using deep learning', Data in Brief, 2021; Sekilab CRDDC 2022.
rdd2022.redistribution_notes: Mendeley RDD2020 (DOI: 10.17632/5ty2wb6gvg.1) is explicitly licensed under CC BY-NC 3.0 (NonCommercial). Academic prototype and research benchmarking is permitted with attribution. Commercial redistribution is restricted. Multi-gigabyte tarballs require manual prerequisite staging; automated script scraping is prohibited to avoid bandwidth exhaustion.

taco.official_name: TACO: Trash Annotations in Context for Litter Detection
taco.attribution_requirement: Pedro F. Proença and Pedro Simões, 'TACO: Trash Annotations in Context for Litter Detection', 2020.
taco.redistribution_notes: Annotations are CC-BY-SA 4.0; underlying Flickr images carry individual licenses. Forensic inspection of annotations.json reveals 715/1500 images (47.7%) have license=None. Only images with verified Creative Commons or ODbL licenses may be cleared for inclusion; unverified Flickr assets are excluded from benchmark.

boston311.license: ODC-PDDL (Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License)
boston311.attribution_requirement: City of Boston, Analyze Boston Open Data / 311 Service Requests
boston311.annotation_format: CKAN Datastore / CSV with citizen and closed photo URLs
boston311.redistribution_notes: Dedicated to the public domain under ODC-PDDL by the City of Boston Department of Innovation and Technology (DoIT). Citizen and municipal work photos are hosted on Cloudinary and cleared for benchmark inclusion with privacy safeguards.

nyc311.official_name: NYC 311 Service Requests from 2010 to Present
nyc311.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use (Public Domain equivalent)
nyc311.attribution_requirement: City of New York Open Data / 311
nyc311.annotation_format: CSV / Socrata API (Text and metadata only)
nyc311.redistribution_notes: NYC 311 publishes 48 tabular columns with zero citizen photo URLs or attachments. Not cleared for visual benchmark inclusion due to absence of image media. Suitable solely as a civic complaint taxonomy and text reference.

wikimedia_water.official_name: Wikimedia Commons & Geograph Infrastructure (Water Leakage and Pipe Breaks)
wikimedia_water.attribution_requirement: Individual photographers / Geograph Project / Wikimedia Commons
wikimedia_water.redistribution_notes: Images are published under verified Creative Commons (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA) or Public Domain terms with detailed photographic descriptions of pipe bursts, water main breaks, and municipal water leaks. Cleared for benchmark inclusion.

wikimedia_streetlight.redistribution_notes: Images are published under verified Creative Commons (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA) or Public Domain terms depicting municipal street lamps, lamp posts, and public lighting fixtures. Cleared for benchmark inclusion.
